name: Peter Pan's Flight
sensoryNotes: Suspended flying galleon gliding over London and Neverland with vibrant UV blacklight scenery.
adhdTip: Continuous moving boarding belt. Very popular queue; aim for early rope drop or during evening fireworks.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean
sensoryNotes: Atmospheric boat voyage with indoor cannon fire, battle audio, two minor water drops, and dim lighting.
adhdTip: Ear defenders advised during the fortress cannonade. The queue area is dark, cool, and spacious.

name: Big Thunder Mountain
sensoryNotes: Runaway mine train racing around an island with roaring track audio, sudden sharp turns, and dark underwater tunnels.
adhdTip: Queue line can echo loudly under the timber shelter. Prepare cautious children for the final pitch-black tunnel dive.

name: Phantom Manor
sensoryNotes: Gothic ghost tour with stretching portrait rooms, spooky orchestrations, singing skeletons, and brief pitch blackouts.
adhdTip: Pre-show holding room includes a brief moment of complete darkness paired with a thunderclap scream.

name: Star Wars Hyperspace Mountain
sensoryNotes: High-velocity indoor coaster with catapult launch, 3 inversions, flashing lasers, and blaring John Williams music.
adhdTip: High physical intensity and restraint vibration. Keep head back firmly against the headrest.

name: it's a small world
sensoryNotes: Gentle, colourful canal cruise with singing animatronic dolls. Bright pastel lighting throughout.
adhdTip: Repetitive catchy theme tune; an ideal low-intensity sensory decompression ride.

name: Buzz Lightyear Laser Blast
sensoryNotes: Interactive laser-firing dark ride with joystick spin control, arcade sound effects, and neon robot targets.
adhdTip: Tactile and engaging; riders can control the spinning speed of the cruiser or leave it facing forward.

name: Star Tours: The Adventures Continue
sensoryNotes: 3D motion flight simulator with hydraulic cabin movement, rapid flight drops, and blasters.
adhdTip: Children can take off 3D glasses if visual motion simulator dizziness occurs.

name: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Peril
sensoryNotes: Outdoor mine cart coaster with sudden drops, sharp turns, and a tight 360-degree vertical inversion loop.
adhdTip: Coaster track is relatively bumpy; ensure smaller teens brace their shoulders against padded restraints.

name: Blanche-Neige et les Sept Nains
sensoryNotes: Classic dark ride featuring the Evil Queen, transformation effects, and spooky haunted trees.
adhdTip: Features sudden turns and jump reveals from the Wicked Witch; can startle younger toddlers.

name: Les Voyages de Pinocchio
sensoryNotes: Wood cart dark ride detailing Stromboli's cage, Pleasure Island donkeys, and Monstro the Whale.
adhdTip: Similar pacing to Snow White; slightly dimmer lighting.

name: Dumbo the Flying Elephant
sensoryNotes: Gentle circular aerial spinner with altitude control joystick.
adhdTip: Unshaded queue; great visible overview of Fantasyland.

name: Mad Hatter's Tea Cups
sensoryNotes: Centrifugal spinning teacups under an open glass canopy.
adhdTip: Center wheel controls spin rate; you can keep the cup completely still if desired.

name: Casey Jr. – Le Petit Train du Cirque
sensoryNotes: Charming junior roller coaster through miniature fairy-tale villages.
adhdTip: Great introductory starter coaster for cautious children.

name: Le Pays des Contes de Fées
sensoryNotes: Peaceful outdoor canal cruise passing miniature Disney storybook castles.
adhdTip: Very calming; zero drops or sudden loud sounds.

name: Autopia
sensoryNotes: Petrol-powered mini race cars along a guide rail track.
adhdTip: Gasoline fumes and engine rumbling present; tactile steering.

name: Orbitron
sensoryNotes: High-altitude rotating retro rocket ships with pilot control lever.
adhdTip: Flies higher than Dumbo; great evening view of Discoveryland.

name: Le Carrousel de Lancelot
sensoryNotes: Traditional grand carousel with carved horses, gentle organ music, and canopy lighting.
adhdTip: Gentle, soothing motion. Outer horses are stationary for cautious younger riders.

name: Thunder Mesa Riverboat Landing
sensoryNotes: Scenic paddle-steamer boat tour around Rivers of the Far West with wilderness audio.
adhdTip: Excellent sensory decompression space with benches and open river breezes.

name: Disneyland Railroad
sensoryNotes: Authentic steam train circling the entire park with Grand Canyon diorama sound effects.
adhdTip: Great transportation option to rest tired feet between lands.

name: Main Street Vehicles
sensoryNotes: Charming vintage cars, fire engines, and paddy wagons taking a one-way trip up Main Street.
adhdTip: Operates mostly in the mornings; delightful low-key ride for toddlers.

name: La Tanière du Dragon
sensoryNotes: Walkthrough cave under the castle with an enormous animatronic dragon that awakens and growls.
adhdTip: Self-paced walkthrough; easy to exit immediately if child feels intimidated.

name: Alice's Curious Labyrinth
sensoryNotes: Outdoor hedge maze with water fountains, singing cards, and Queen of Hearts castle lookout.
adhdTip: Great tactile space for active children to explore at their own pace.

name: Adventure Isle & Swiss Family Treehouse
sensoryNotes: Rope suspension bridges, pirate caves, skull rock tunnels, and giant treehouse climb.
adhdTip: Unstructured outdoor play space ideal for burning excess physical energy.

name: Les Mystères du Nautilus
sensoryNotes: Walkthrough recreation of Captain Nemo's submarine with bubble effects, organ music, and a giant squid encounter.
adhdTip: Dimly lit, quiet indoor attraction with gentle ambient sea sounds.

name: Le Passage Enchanté d'Aladdin
sensoryNotes: Intimate stone walkway featuring miniature window dioramas telling Aladdin's story.
adhdTip: Very quiet, self-paced, and rarely crowded.

name: La Galerie de la Belle au Bois Dormant
sensoryNotes: Stained glass windows, woven tapestries, and castle balcony overlook.
adhdTip: Calm, beautiful space inside Sleeping Beauty Castle.

name: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
sensoryNotes: Accelerated vertical freefall elevator drops with stomach-floating sensations, spooky ghosts, and loud metallic sound effects.
adhdTip: Suspenseful pre-show and sudden drops. High sensory intensity.

name: Crush's Coaster
sensoryNotes: Spinning turtle shell coaster plunging through the dark East Australian Current with sharp drops.
adhdTip: Queue moves slowly. Visualise spinning in darkness before riding.

name: Ratatouille: The Adventure
sensoryNotes: Trackless 3D glasses ride with heat/cold physical blasts, water sprays, and quick scurrying motions.
adhdTip: 3D glasses can be removed if visual simulation triggers dizziness.

name: Avengers Assemble: Flight Force
sensoryNotes: High-velocity inverted launch coaster with Iron Man and Captain Marvel LED screens in near-total darkness.
adhdTip: Catapult launch accelerates 0 to 60mph in under 3 seconds.

name: Spider-Man W.E.B. Adventure
sensoryNotes: Interactive 3D screen attraction requiring repetitive arm movements to sling virtual webs at Spider-Bots.
adhdTip: Highly engaging and active; great for sensory output.

name: RC Racer
sensoryNotes: Half-pipe shuttle coaster with intense vertical climbs and stomach-drop sensations.
adhdTip: Riders sit high on a steep orange track; high visual exposure.

name: Toy Soldiers Parachute Drop
sensoryNotes: Controlled parachute drop tower offering rhythmic rises, gentle drops, and panoramic views.
adhdTip: Gentle intro to drop rides before attempting Tower of Terror.

name: Slinky Dog Zigzag Spin
sensoryNotes: Circular undulating caterpillar ride around a giant dog bowl.
adhdTip: Low sensory stimulation; very toddler-friendly.

name: Cars ROAD TRIP
sensoryNotes: Tram tour featuring a flash flood and fire canyon demonstration with real water and heat blasts.
adhdTip: Canyon catastrophe scene creates sudden flame and loud water deluge.

name: Cars Quatre Roues Rallye
sensoryNotes: Spinning car ride with figure-eight rotating turntable motion in Radiator Springs.
adhdTip: Centrifugal turns without height drops; fun for young Pixar fans.

name: Les Tapis Volants - Flying Carpets Over Agrabah
sensoryNotes: Rotating aerial carpet spinner with front-row tilt and back-row height control levers.
adhdTip: Similar to Dumbo; riders control their altitude directly.

name: Raiponce Tangled Spin
sensoryNotes: Gentle spinning boat attraction floating under glowing floating lanterns.
adhdTip: Smooth, beautiful family ride inspired by Tangled's lantern scene.

name: Frozen Ever After
sensoryNotes: Musical dark boat voyage to Elsa's Ice Palace with animatronics, singing, backward slide, and minor water drop.
adhdTip: Features a short backward track glide followed by a mild splash drop.

name: TOGETHER: a Pixar Musical Adventure
sensoryNotes: West End-quality live indoor theatre featuring an eight-piece live orchestra, multi-sensory water droplets, and scents.
adhdTip: Comfortable indoor tiered seating; arrive 25 mins prior.

name: The Lion King: Rhythms of the Pride Lands
sensoryNotes: Acrobatic musical spectacular with high-decibel live drumming, aerialists swinging over the audience, and rich lighting.
adhdTip: Dynamic and loud. Ear defenders recommended for sound-sensitive kids.

name: Mickey and the Magician
sensoryNotes: Broadway-style illusions with classic Disney musical numbers, dancing, and stage magic.
adhdTip: Rapid scene changes hold attention well.

name: Stitch Live!
sensoryNotes: Interactive digital screen comedy show where animated Stitch talks and jokes directly with audience members in real time.
adhdTip: Floor mat seating up front for kids; relaxed and interactive.

name: Disney Stars on Parade
sensoryNotes: Daytime parade with loud mobile sound systems, costumed characters, and a dragon breathing fire.
adhdTip: Crowds line Main Street early. Stand near 'it's a small world' for easy departures.

name: Disney Tales of Magic Nighttime Spectacular
sensoryNotes: Castle projection show accompanied by drone swarms, laser arrays, and fireworks.
adhdTip: High crowd density. Stand toward the Main Street Train Station for a clearer exit route.

name: Disney Dreams! Nighttime Fireworks
sensoryNotes: Classic castle projection and pyrotechnic show with water fountains, laser beams, and fireworks.
adhdTip: Ear defenders strongly recommended during the loud finale bursts.

name: Disney Halloween Festival Cavalcade
sensoryNotes: Autumn parade featuring Mickey's Illusion Manor float, lively pumpkin dancers, and classic Disney Villains.
adhdTip: Vibrant and upbeat rather than genuinely scary; great introductory Halloween fun.

name: Mickey's Dazzling Christmas Parade
sensoryNotes: Illuminated holiday floats, festive musical anthems, simulated snowfall along Main Street, and Santa Claus.
adhdTip: Runs both daytime and after dark; the evening version features glowing tree lighting stops.

name: Hero Training Center
sensoryNotes: Interactive character experience with Spider-Man, Iron Man, or Captain Marvel featuring high-speed 360-degree dynamic photo capture.
adhdTip: Requires booking via the Disneyland Paris app Virtual Queue.
